title: Commercial Building, 102-104 1/2 East Main Street, Madison, Jefferson County, IN
notes: Significance: The Foster Building was erected ca. 1860-70 and has the best cast-iron facade of Madison's late nineteenth-century commercial architecture.  Most of the city's five-block commercial row development is finished with sheet-metal and cast-iron facades.  This structure, however, stands out as the most ornate and finest in design.
Unprocessed Field note material exists for this structure: FN-32
